sklearn.notes: Core sklearn semi_supervised estimators; always available.

industry.notes: Iterative pseudo-labeling with XGBoost/LightGBM when installed. Falls back to sklearn self_training when industry extra missing.

torch.notes: FixMatch/MixMatch-style consistency + pseudo-label training for numeric tabular features (buildml[torch]).

hf.notes: Sentence-transformer embeddings + pseudo-label self-training on a single text feature column (buildml[ssl]).

documented_pipeline: transform_ssl or reduce_dimensions on SSL embeddings
fit_semisupervised with partial labels on embedding columns
ssl_integration.finetune_ssl_head: Labeled train rows only — use fit_semisupervised when unlabeled train rows should participate via propagation/pseudo-labels.

evaluation.holdout_rule: labeled rows only; unlabeled holdout never scored as truth

install_hints.torch: pip install 'buildml[torch]'  # FixMatch/MixMatch tabular consistency training
install_hints.ssl: pip install 'buildml[ssl]'  # HF text pseudo-label via sentence-transformers

non_goals: Full computer-vision FixMatch on raw pixels

floor_note: Industry/torch backends should meet or exceed sklearn baseline on this synthetic partial-label task when extras are installed.
